board-canvass: Final Canvass of Results, General Election of November 3, 2020
sos-precincts: 2020 General Election, precinct results (one workbook per county)

notes: Certified by the State Canvassing Board on 2020-11-23; listed on https://www.sos.alabama.gov/alabama-votes/voter/election-information/2020. Real text (2020's pages are turned a quarter turn): every table is read whole.

Alabama Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Elections Data' page (https://www.sos.alabama.gov/alabama-votes/voter/election-data): one workbook per county, every contest on its ballot by precinct, with the county's absentee and provisional columns. The results the counties certified; for every contest the State Canvassing Board also certifies, each county's sums are compared with the Board's canvass (checks named 'al: ...').
gaps: 52 contests: how many were to be elected

The county workbooks do not print how many each voter could choose, and for these contests no precinct wholly inside the contest shows it in its votes, over votes and under votes (many are constables). They are stored with no seat count and no winner. First: Member, County Commission, District 1 (Autauga County); Member, County Commission, District 3 (Autauga County); Member, County Commission, District 5 (Autauga County); Member, County Board of Education, District 3 (Barbour County); Member, County Board of Education, District 4 (Barbour County).
